title: Multiplicity One for Five Strongly Tempered Spherical Varieties
summary: Let $F$ be a non-Archimedean local field of characteristic zero. We prove multiplicity one for every irreducible smooth admissible representation in the split forms of Wan-Zhang Models 6-10. Combining the Gelfand-Kazhdan method with nilpotent-wavefront restrictions on Bernstein-finite equivariant distributions, we establish the required symmetries through rational orbit analysis, parabolic descent, stabilizer characters, and conormal arguments.
